title: Béla IV & the Rebuilding - IV. Béla és az újjáépítés
grammar: Rebuilding & settlement verbs: újjáépít, letelepít, behív, visszatér

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain why the Mongols abruptly left Hungary in spring 1242.
I can describe IV. Béla's estate and settlement policies.
I can explain why IV. Béla is called the 'Second Founder of the State'.
I can use verbs with the prefix újjá- and settlement terms.
